Ms. M. M. Deshmukh, App for the State.

The learned App seeks time to verify the criminal antecedents
 of the present applicant.

2. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the issue
 as to whether Section 328 of the Ipc is applicable to the tobacco
 products or not is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

Considering the said fact and as time is sought by the learned App, I

entities.text:
I
Rajan @ Rishikesh Vasant Bandgar vs The State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
(i) In the event of arrest of applicant-Rajan @ Rishikesh Vasant Bandgar in connection with Crime No.538 of 2022 registered at Faujdar Chawadi Police Station, Solapur for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(ii),
26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, he shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five Thousand only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall attend the concerned police station from 01 November, 2022 to 03 November, 2022 between 11.00 a.m. to 02.00 p.m. and shall co-operate in the investigation.
3. List the application for further consideration on 23 November, 2022.

( N.R. BORKAR, J. )
